instruction: Set up a 30-minute call with Kenji at 9am Thursday his time. He's in Tokyo.
final_text:
I set up the call and sent the invite to Kenji Watanabe (kenji@tsubame.example).

- **Kenji's time:** Thursday 1 Oct, 9:00–9:30 AM in Tokyo
- **Your time:** Wednesday 30 Sep, 5:00–5:30 PM Pacific

Because of the time difference, the call lands on **Wednesday evening** for you, not Thursday. You're free then; your last meeting that day ends at 4:00. It also matches what Kenji said earlier about your late afternoons being best for calls.

The invite is titled "Sam / Kenji call" and lists the time in both zones. It has no video link or location yet. If you meant 9am Thursday your time instead, tell me and I'll move it.
